name: Creamy Aji green sauce
author: bbcgoodfood.com
steps: Put all the ingredients in a blender or food processor and mix into a sauce. Add seasoning, then pour into a serving bowl.

culture.text: Green sauce or greensauce is a family of cold, uncooked sauces based on chopped herbs, including the Spanish and Italian salsa verde, the French sauce verte, the German grüne Soße or Frankfurter grie Soß, the British mint sauce and greensauce, and the Argentine chimichurri.
